newsitem.title: GREECE: SOCCER-SEVILLA MIDFIELDER MARINAKIS RETURNS TO GREECE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SEVILLA MIDFIELDER MARINAKIS RETURNS TO GREECE.

text.p: Sevilla's Greek midfielder Petros Marinakis will be returning home in about a week to sign with a Greek club, Greek soccer federation officials said on Wednesday.
"We expect him back in about a week. The Sevilla coach has said he does not need him any more and he will sign with a Greek club," one official said.
Marinakis was signed by Sevilla at the start of the season. --Costas Paris, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
